dimensions.name: Task Success (containerized verifier, pass rate over trials)
dimensions.scoring_formula: pass_rate = trials with verifier reward 1 / trials; score = 100 * pass_rate snapped to the nearest tier

score_synthesis.formula: total_score = D1. Per-trial reward is binary and comes only from the entry's verifier, run inside the task environment after the agent stops (outcome-based, the agent never sees it).
notes: Multiple trials are required because single agent runs are high-variance.
Infrastructure failures (sandbox start, build) are recorded per trial as infra_error and count as 0; rerun if infra_error appears.
Optional LLM-as-judge dimensions are intentionally omitted: C6 entries are selected for objective, verifier-defined outcomes.

verifier_contract.runs_in: the same sandbox/container the agent used, after the agent finishes
verifier_contract.output: last non-empty stdout line is a JSON object with at least {"reward": 0|1, "reason": str}; optional "checks": [...]
verifier_contract.exit_code: 0 when reward is 1, non-zero otherwise (informational; reward comes from the JSON)
